business_summary: Capital Finance Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, provides short-term financing services in the People's Republic of China and Hong Kong. It offers pawn and entrusted loans, micro-financing services, financial consultancy, entrusted loan, and distressed debt assets management services, as well as money lending, administrative, and consultancy services, as well as information technology solution services. The company was formerly known as Ming Kei Holdings Limited and changed its name to Capital Finance Holdings Limited in November 2014. Capital Finance Holdings Limited was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Capital Finance Holdings Limited는 중화인민공화국과 홍콩에서 단기 금융 서비스를 제공합니다. 전당포 및 수탁대출, 소액금융 서비스, 금융컨설팅, 위탁대출, 부실채권 자산관리 서비스, 자금대출, 행정, ​​컨설팅 서비스, 정보기술 솔루션 서비스를 제공합니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Ming Kei Holdings Limited로 알려져 있었으며 2014년 11월에 Capital Finance Holdings Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. Capital Finance Holdings Limited는 2002년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 완차이에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
